principles: Correctness eligibility is decided before cost optimization.
Every gate-consumed decision must be structured, versioned, signed or digest-bound, and mechanically revalidated.
First-release impact coverage stays narrow; unsupported categories honestly escalate to full.
Read-only observability and lifecycle authority remain separate.
drivers: Prevent invalid incremental passes from satisfying review gates.
Reduce prompt input only where impact closure is provable.
Reuse existing freshness and review evidence facts instead of creating competing truth sources.
Keep operator output explainable through stable reason codes.

options.name: A: Extend the existing read-only command with a shared eligibility and assembly core
pros: Allows handler, assembler, and gates to consume the same typed decision
cons: Requires careful separation between read-only computation and reviewerWrite persistence
Touches several contract and gate integration points

options.name: B: Add a separate incremental assembler command
cons: Makes caller-selected mode easier to misuse

options.name: C: Keep incremental selection in reviewer prompts

chosen: A: Extend the existing read-only command with a shared eligibility and assembly core
rationale: Option A is the only design that preserves the accepted single-source architecture while making eligibility reusable by trusted assembly and gate validation. The command remains observational; persistence occurs only through existing reviewer authority paths.

preMortem.scenario: A caller supplies a flag or forged field to force incremental mode.
preMortem.trigger: Eligibility accepts caller-provided decision state instead of recomputing canonical facts.
preMortem.consequence: An under-scoped review can produce an admissible pass.
preMortem.mitigation: Expose no force-incremental option and recompute the versioned eligibility digest at assembly and pass validation.

preMortem.scenario: Impact classification misses a cross-file or dynamic dependency.
preMortem.trigger: A change category is treated as bounded without a complete supported index or parse result.
preMortem.mitigation: Allow only explicitly proven categories and map unknown language, dynamic reference, incomplete index, and parse failure to full.

preMortem.trigger: Full context exceeds budget while incremental fits.
preMortem.consequence: The system chooses an unsafe smaller prompt.
preMortem.mitigation: Choose correctness mode first, record budget violation separately, and never downgrade full to incremental for cost.

preMortem.scenario: The observational command accidentally mutates evidence or gate state.
preMortem.trigger: Assembly persistence or review-run creation is placed inside review_incremental_context.
preMortem.consequence: Simply inspecting context changes lifecycle readiness.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the handler pure/read-only and retain before/after store and gate snapshot regression tests.

preMortem.scenario: Envelope fields are recorded but not consumed by every review evidence path.
preMortem.trigger: Pass, receipt, floor, or quorum validation uses a legacy path that ignores incremental binding.
preMortem.consequence: A mismatched pass may count downstream.
preMortem.mitigation: Centralize admissibility validation and cover all collectors through the process fact registry verifier and adversarial integration tests.
